Subject: Exec visit + onsite workshop — June 21-22 (Paragon)

Stephanie —

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. We’re excited to host the Redwood team for a two-day workshop with our executive committee on June 21-22 at Paragon HQ (San Francisco). High-level asks from our side:

- 60–75 minute executive briefing with our CEO & CIO on Day 1 (pref. late morning)
- Deep-dive breakout on Day 2 for engineering & product (full day)
- AV run-through and secure room access for three Redwood execs (we expect 2x C-level and 1x Head of Product)

Could you put me in touch with your EA so we can coordinate travel logistics, NDA for pre-read distribution, and any site security requirements? Also please confirm names of the visiting Redwood executives so we can arrange escorts and parking passes.

Best,
Oliver

Hi all —

Draft checklist for Redwood execs arriving June 20-22. Please review and flag gaps. I’ll finalize once Paragon confirms hotel and AV contact.

Arrival / Departures
- Stephanie (CEO escort): preferred arrival SFO 06/20, morning window 09:00–11:00. Flight options to be shared by 5/21.
- CTO: arriving 06/20 evening.
- VP Product: tentative — will confirm by 5/21.

Hotel
- Recommend The Embarcadero (Union Square/Embarcadero hybrid) — walking to Paragon HQ is ~12 min. If Paragon books partner hotel, confirm early check-in and access to secure floor.

Ground Transport
- Black car pick-up from SFO. Meet-and-greet with Paragon security in arrivals. Driver: Rajesh Kumar (vendor) — cell +1 415-555-0999.
- Parking passes: request 2 x VIP spots and 1 x general attendee pass.

Onsite security & badges
- Paragon to provide temporary badges. Need full legal names and DOBs for badge pre-registration by 6/8.

AV & Tech
- AV run-through: 06/21, 08:30–09:30 (preferred) — please confirm onsite A/V contact and whether room is bridged to a secure Zoom instance.
- Required: mic (lapel for speakers), podium laptop HDMI + adapter, confidence monitor, clicker.

Catering
- Executive briefing (light lunch): plated salads + one hot option. Day 2: box lunches for breakout rooms. Dietary restrictions: Stephanie — pescatarian; Marcus — gluten-free.

Pre-reads & NDA
- Please send NDA for signature and the final agenda for pre-read distribution no later than 6/7.

Attachments (drafts): [Attachment: EA-travel-brief.pdf (PDF, 74KB)], [Attachment: paragon_onsite_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 56KB)]
